messages:
alex.w: quick heads-up — we're going to start a compactification migration of the console telemetry payloads next Tues. goal: shrink per-event size by ~25% and make quota math consistent across dashboard and billing pipelines
sana: can you TL;DR the user-visible changes? will any dashboard cards break?
alex.w: TL;DR: metric attributes that are sparse will be moved to a separate attributes table + compact enum ids for common route tags. dashboards should read through the new adapter but we need a READ-FORWARD shim for 2 weeks. no UI model change planned
luca: who owns the read-adapter? is this a runtime proxy or a db view?
alex.w: luca good q — plan is a read-adapter service (stateless) that rewrites queries for the console. it will handle compatibility and rewrite legacy query shapes to the new schema. prototype is in my branch
pm-elisa: timeline? we promised customers a quota stability window next month. need to sync with billing team
alex.w: target canary 1 on Tues AM (internal only), canary 2 Wed (selected tenants), full rollout Fri if no regressions. billing gating: we keep quota calc identical for 30 days — dual-write to both index paths and compare delta
ingrid: how heavy is the backfill? we talked about an envelope rewrite for old events in storage earlier
alex.w: backfill plan: incremental rewrite using a streaming job. it will create attribute records and replace large payloads with compact refs. backfill rate limit set to 5% of cluster IO to avoid spikes
sana: what's the rollback story if we find regressions in console queries?
luca: +1 — also need a fast read-only fallback that keeps the old schema available for reads for N mins after deploy
alex.w: rollback: we can flip the read-adapter to legacy mode (reads from old tables) instantly. writes will remain dual-write for the backfill period. also adding a canary flag to disable compact enums if needed
pm-elisa: dependency list for rollout: console-adapter PR, streaming backfill job, billing-compare job, docs for support, dashboard smoke tests. assign owners?
alex.w: owners: adapter -> luca, backfill -> sana, billing-compare -> ingrid, tests/docs -> me + elisa. i'll open PRs tonight
ingrid: for billing-compare, do we plan tokenized unit parity or raw size parity? the migration changes stored attributes which may affect token estimates
alex.w: good nuance — billing-compare will use existing charge calculation (post-hoc) on both old and new reads to validate unit counts. if delta > 1% we stop the rollout
luca: snippet of adapter rewrite rule (very rough):
```
SELECT r.route_id, a.attr_key_id, a.attr_value_id
FROM routes_compact rc
LEFT JOIN route_attrs a ON rc.id = a.route_id
WHERE rc.t >= $since
```
we'll translate legacy JSON flatten->these joins at runtime
sana: tests: can we add simulated tenant load that mixes heavy prefix-cached requests and small chat-embedding telemetry? we should validate latency SLOs for console queries
alex.w: yes — load test in staging with realistic route mixes. if p99 increases > 30ms we hold
pm-elisa: UX: add a console banner for affected tenants during canary and show a toggle in admin to opt-out of compact view until we complete backfill
ingrid: data-retention change? compacting might change how we prune attributes. need to update retention policy docs and TTL mapping
alex.w: noted. we'll map old payload TTL -> attribute TTL and ensure pruning job sweeps both tables in sync
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-1 at 2024-05-07T09:00:00Z -> canary-2 2024-05-08T13:00:00Z -> full 2024-05-10T18:00:00Z (manual gates required) :rocket:
sana: I'll own rollback runbook and toggles. will add to runbook doc and ping infra for runway
luca: I'll open adapter PR and include a feature-flag gate and telemetry events for adapter-mode.

alex.w: thanks — action items: luca open PR, sana backfill job + runbook, ingrid billing compare pipeline, elisa docs + tenant banner copy. will post checklist in the morning. :thumbsup:
pm-elisa: cool. small ask — ensure the read-adapter emits `compat_mode` metric so we can chart errors vs adapter mode
alex.w: will do. putting a small schema migration checklist in the PR template too
ingrid: during backfill, can we sample 0.1% of events and run full decode to detect data-drift? want to catch malformed attribute refs early
sana: yes, that'll be in the job — sample+alert if mismatch rate > 0.01%
luca: heads-up: console query plans changed a bit in my local tests — adding an index on route_attrs(attr_key_id, route_id) lowers p99 for joins
alex.w: please include the index DDL in PR and coordinate with infra for maintenance window. thanks all
pm-elisa: nice work. will sync with support and send a short customer comms draft after PRs land
alex.w: end of thread for now, i'll update when PRs are up. :wave:
